rubric.high: Core claims are directly documented and corroborated by credible references, with historical scope stated. This is an editorial evidence grade, not a statistical probability.
rubric.medium: A conventional/approximate date, conflicting chronology, weaker reference or contextual interpretation remains material to the entry.
rubric.low: Important claims lack adequate support. Remove or narrow them before promotion; no entry is upgraded solely because its URL count increases.
rubric.sourceDiversity: Multiple URLs or hostnames do not prove independence: operator pages, artist testimony, government/tourism promotion and archive metadata have different scopes. No automated percentage is assigned.
rubric.reviewMethod: This pass used retrieved page text and indexed search excerpts/abstracts; full books, paywalled chapters and every cited PDF were not read in full. Reference-specific limitations are retained below.
